HEEWON STYLE — a premium KOREAN WEBTOON / MANHWA splash illustration of a relationship, lit with cinematic tenebrism. A 2:1 movie frame composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop (nothing important at the top or bottom edge). MEDIUM CLOSE TWO-SHOT, waist-up, both faces large. DRAW IT EXACTLY IN THE STYLE OF THE ATTACHED CHARACTER SHEET: the same clean confident black ink linework, the same manhwa face design (eye shape, brows, nose, jaw, hairline and hair). It must read as an INKED DRAWING: visible line strokes everywhere — bold tapered contour lines around every figure, drawn fold lines in the silk and armour, hair drawn as inked strands, a little cross-hatching and line shading in the shadows — then flat cel-shading in two or three tones per colour, no airbrushed gradients. Each face must be recognisably the character drawn on the sheet, wearing the same clothes. NOT realistic, NOT an oil painting, NOT photoreal, NOT painterly, NOT a 3D render, no skin pores or photographic texture. ONLY THESE TWO PEOPLE in the frame. THE ROYAL GIRL WHO DECIDED FIRST. Manmyung strides toward the camera through the rain, unhurried, chin up, a small satisfied smile, towing Seohyun behind her by the hand. Seohyun, young and CLEAN-SHAVEN, soaked, flustered, mouth open, completely outmatched. Orange firelight from behind them (a burning gate, off-frame) and white rain streaks; lilac on her, blue on him. CHARACTER SHEET (copy these faces, hair and clothes exactly): LEFT of the sheet = KIM SEOHYUN; RIGHT of the sheet = MANMYUNG. KIM SEOHYUN — Look: Gentle long face, apologetic eyes, a careful mouth; a softer cousin of young Yushin's face, never the same man. Completely clean-shaven and long-haired when young (loose topknot, long strands past the jaw); a thin moustache and short beard from his forties. Now: Young official in his twenties, CLEAN-SHAVEN, no beard or moustache: steel-blue silk po, white collar, dark sash, jougwan cap over a loose topknot with long loose strands. Colour #3E8EF0. | MANMYUNG — Look: Young royal Kim noblewoman whose face runs in the family: mostly her granddaughter Gotaso's (oval face, bright almond eyes, small nose, cheerful sly mouth) with a touch of her daughter Munhee's long jaw and arched brows; one eyebrow up, a closed-mouth smirk. Black hair in a high round bun with loose strands at the temples, one gold binyeo with a red bead, small gold hoop earrings. Dress: Short white silk jeogori with deep crimson collar ribbon and cuffs, long deep-crimson chima with a gold-embroidered waistband, a pale celadon-green shawl; good silk she will ruin in the rain. Colour #c98bb9. LIGHT AND BACKGROUND (dark manhwa tenebrism, like a dramatic manhwa splash page): a MINIMAL MONOTONE background — one flat dark field in a single hue (the characters' colour deepened almost to black), at most a few soft wisps of smoke in that same hue; no set, no architecture, no landscape, no furniture, no props beyond what the characters hold or sit on; ONE hard directional light from the side or below carves the faces and silk in high contrast, the far side of each figure falling off into black shadow, a thin edge of the same light along the silhouettes; deep inky blacks, crisp highlights, strong cast shadows across the faces. Each person's colour is the colour of the light and the shadow-tint on them — never a glow aura or halo. BLOCKING, BODY LANGUAGE AND FACIAL EXPRESSIONS show the relationship at a glance. Faces and clothes from the sheet; new poses, never the sheet's stance. One of each person, never cloned. No text, no lettering, no speech bubbles, no panel borders, no watermark.
